name: Dull Donkey 18
author: estefaniarizzo
description: Neon gradient 3d rounded green button that lifts and glows on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes translateY(-2px) rotateX(20deg) rotateY(10deg), box-shadow becomes 0 8px 16px #000000, 0 0 0 4px #000000 inset, background changes from linear-gradient(45deg, #4caf50, #ffc107, #2196f3) to linear-gradient(45deg, #02ff0e, #fc0000, #ae00ff). On focus, the outline is removed.
